notes.title: Update 6: Shadows of the Past
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/fede6cb1c440c39a562c27f632bc7a9e9e60bc6a.png"]

A faint radio signal from a long forgotten facility could save the future of civilization. But to get there, brave Survivors will have to venture deep into the deadly heart of the old world.

The Settlers will need to develop new technologies, fight back a growing zombie threat and expand civilization to secure their fate…

It's an all new, major expansion for the game!


New Campaign
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/0ca9d257308ca48be0e7a02a57b000f7ebc25b4d.png"]

Establish Settlements across 10 new levels and discover what lies deep in the shadows of the old world.


New Buildings: Outposts, Logistics Posts & Forts
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/3c6cebd04ace65117f67c7f26765febfbff5f238.png"]

Construct Outposts to assist with production and combat, then specialise them further into Logistics Posts or Forts.


Infested Borders
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/7466224674d78a3a08e7f4f40dbaac1a625ef9b2.png"]

Fight back against distant infestations plaguing the region. Zombies will be continually drawn towards your Settlements!


New Population & Technology
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/dd6859f0f27a68c815c809d74d6861aa28c70038.png"]

Expand your Settlements even further with new services and higher level production buildings.


Changelog
New Campaign: Discover a forgotten research lab amidst the ruins in 10 new Levels

Infested Borders: Fight back against distant infestations plaguing the region

Expanded Civilization: Use Outposts to boost your settlement as well as new buildings, Population and Tech Levels

Additions

Added Shadows of the Past Campaign (10 new levels)

New Buildings - Upgradable Outpost: Benefit from improved resource production and combat strength, further specialise the Outpost with Logistics or Fort upgrades

Infested Borders: Zombies will be continually drawn towards your Settlements!

New Rewards: All new rewards from the Shadows of the Past Campaign

New Population & Technology Levels: Upgrade to Population 14 and Technology 7

Added Ingenuity Soundtrack to campaign rotation

Balance Changes

Buildings built further from the Settlement now cost slightly more Stamina

Herb Gardens now require Stone to build from Level 3

Lumberyards now require Stone to Build from Level 6

Deer, Cow, and Sheep Material buildings now require Wood to build

Stone Quarries cost more Wood and less Stamina to build

High-level production buildings cost increasing amounts of Wood and Stone

Festivals now improve Celebration Chance

Celebrations now increase Final Score

Escape Hatch mode no longer reduces Final Score

Quality of Life

Disable Tips: You can now disable Tip Popups in game settings. Let us know how you find this feature and if there are other popups we should be labelling as Tips!

When Areas are under attack, building health bars become larger

Bug Fixes 

Fixed a rare issue where the Context Menu would not correctly update initial priorities 

Fixed an issue where the "Maintain X Resource" objective would complete when you loaded the game

Stability improvements


What's Next?
We've got lots more coming soon for After Inc: Revival. Check out our Roadmap! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/e1f7cfb9e5a32444f5e60f020bfab5a90fb236d6.png"]

But also be sure to let us know what you'd like to see in the forums, on discord, and on our reddit.

notes.title: Update 5 - Looming Shadows
notes.notes:
In our fifth major update, we've made some big changes to give you more options as you rebuild the world, implement more satisfying combat and lay the groundwork for the Shadows of the Past campaign.


Zombies & Combat
We've adjusted Zombie awakenings to be more predictable, now based on your actions and how much attention you've brought to your settlement. Settlement size and weather also factor in, so keep an eye out!

Fighters will now consume resources when in unclaimed zones, are stronger when taunting, and the Reinforce ability is always available. 



Morale - Celebrations
To reward keeping your Morale high, we've added Celebrations. You'll get a gift of Stamina and a reduction of Impatience (based on Settlement Size). The happier your people are, the more likely they'll celebrate.

High morale now also improves your Population Growth and Fighter Strength.


Population
Once you get to higher populations, Demands will be more reasonable, baseline population growth speed will be reduced, and Morale will have a greater impact on Population Growth.


Changelog
New Features

Added Celebration mechanic. Chance to get Celebration bubbles when morale >100% (capped by population)

Added Zombie Awareness mechanic. Increased by Claiming/Fighter movement as well as Settlement activity and Weather. Makes zombies more likely to wake and makes zombies join existing fights more quickly. Zombies attacking into an existing fight will make things worse based on Awareness

Added Gluttons expedition modifier

Added Stretched Supply Chains expedition modifier

Added High Maintenance expedition modifier

Added Warrior Ethos expedition modifier

Balance Changes

Population 6 onwards: Population demands made more reasonable

Population 6 onwards: Baseline Population Growth Speed reduced

Population 6 onwards: Morale has a greater impact on Population Growth

+Population Trait boosted

+Morale Trait boosted

Fighters now consume Water, Food, and Fuel when in unclaimed areas.

Shrine service - now needed 1 population later. Going from 10 to 11 population will no longer result in such a big morale drop

Increased impact of Reanimation modifier

Reduced randomness of Reanimation 

Quality of Life

Updated building action logic to always remain above Storage and Scavenge actions.

Improved Leader Bubbles artwork

Improved Enemy Warning Icon artwork

Fighters will prepare for battle when taunting - boosting their strength

Fighters will try to be quiet when moving near zombies (but will move slower). Typically a fighter will never wake up a group of zombies if this is your first time in contact with them.

A fighter retreating now results in a lingering combat penalty for a while in that area (other fighters are scared to go there)

Reinforce is now introduced in level 5, and available at game start after that.

Taunt and Reinforce actions are now available in early campaign missions if their introduction levels (Level 4 and level 5) have been beaten.

Festivals now boost population growth speed

Research and Fighter training now faster with higher populations

Bug Fixes

Fixes for Morale icons

Fixed a variety of visual issues with map bubbles.

Fixed an issue where Rain may not start after a Drought

Fixed an issue where Goals could have too high a threshold in Expeditions

Fixed bug where Zombies would keep moving to different area if Fighter attacking them

Fixed bug where Zombies might be killed too quickly when entering an area

Fixed an issue with Goal target thresholds


What's Next?
We're making progress on a brand new campaign: Shadows of the Past: New levels, new zombie mechanics and a new tech level! Not to mention find out what happens next in the Abandoned Kingdom.

Be sure to leave us a review if you're enjoying the game! or join our Discord to chat with us, try exclusive betas and swap tactics on how to rebuild the world.

notes.title: Update 4 - Build Cancelling
notes.notes:
Our fourth update lets you undo your mistakes.

This was a very popular request from players, you wanted to change your builds on the fly. Thanks to everyone for your feedback and especially those who voted in our development poll so far. 

FYI - the game has now been out for more than a month! This is our fourth major update (+5 smaller patches). We are working at full speed and you can read more about what we are working on at the end of this post.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/cdd7d743f0652e0d94ac3486a2cf62aa4a670f21.png"]
Build Cancelling
We've all been there, you line up a series of important building orders, but then the Zombies attack! You need that Stamina to get a Fighter out there immediately. In the past, you'd have to sit with your choices. But not anymore!

Go to an in-progress construction. If it's yellow, then you can click to cancel it and get a full refund of your Stamina and Resources. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/6e11bff0d9372ef957bcbaad2c00d32be4d5a803.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/f9eb45123dbaaf0d8b833f79d0b56dd18e26a6ce.jpg"]

We're excited to see how this changes up your building and rebuilding of civilization. 


Full Changelog
New Features & Content

Added Build Cancelling - If the construction bar is yellow, click it and have the option to cancel your construction for a full refund!

Added Fuel Reserves Depleted Decision

Added Water Reserves Depleted Decision 

Quality of Life

Added hover animation to the 'show all resources' button in the top left of the in game UI

Improved text wrapping in Decision descriptions

UI polish and improvements

Bug Fixes

Fixed issue where Population Traits and Leader select screen would change when re-entering with Escape Hatch mode enabled

Fixed issue where the game would not paused during the "Not Enough Resource" popup when triggered from the  Right-Click Context Menu

Fixed issue where some Maintain Morale objectives could not be completed with the Stand Together cheat enabled
What's Next?
We're making progress on a brand new campaign: Shadows of the Past: New levels, new zombie mechanics and a new tech level! Not to mention find out what happens next in the Abandoned Kingdom.

Be sure to leave us a review if you're enjoying the game! or join our Discord to chat with us, try exclusive betas and swap tactics on how to rebuild the world.

notes.title: Update 3: Direct Control
notes.notes:
Our third update is all about power and control by using the right click mouse button! Experienced players can now control exactly where new buildings are constructed. It also provides another way to quickly navigate around the UI (along with the existing hot keys) 



Thanks to everyone for your feedback and especially those who voted in our development poll so far. More information on what other things we are working on below.


Direct Control
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/80c9e87bf19cf890d1f5d232ac631f198e0f629a.png"]

Our new update includes a simple but powerful tool, right click on any Area and you'll be able to perform a variety of options:

Strategically choose your Resource Building locations. Do you want to build cheaply - but close to zombies - or prioritize building in a secure Areas or closer to the Settlement?

Build housing and services in your settlement without having to open the Settlement menu

Easily take actions like Explore or Claim Areas without having to move your mouse or using hotkeys



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/38fd2b45f3be48cd58f3939284386e368248fa40.jpg"]
Full Changelog
New Features

Added 'Reset Settings' option

Helpful if you've accidentally selected and approved the wrong resolution!

Quality of Life

Corner numeral icons updated to be more legible

Bug Fixes

Fixed the settlement name not updating for events after the frog collecting decision

notes.title: Update 2: Escape Hatch
notes.notes:
Two weeks after launch, our second major update smashes open the emergency exit and escapes onto Steam - adding a whole new way to replay campaigns…



This was a very popular request from players who wanted to be able to replay campaign maps without knowing exactly where everything is. Thanks to everyone for your feedback and especially those who voted in our development poll so far. 



FYI - the game has now been out for 2 weeks. This is our second major update (+3 smaller patches). We are working at full speed and you can read more about what we are working on at the end of this post.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/e689fd6c4a4d13155fec1f1654880bd400fab172.png"]
Escape Hatch
After completing a Campaign level, a new option will open up: the Escape Hatch mode.



Enabling it lets Survivors use a new exit to leave the bunker! Starting location, terrain and enemies are reshuffled so you don't know exactly what is out there...



Can you still build a thriving settlement if you emerged on the other side of the region? What if meat was scarce? Or forests far away?



It's a brand new challenge every time with some special surprises.


Full Changelog
New Features

Added Escape Hatch Mode

Developer note - a player requested feature to improve replayability of the campaign levels

Expeditions will now leave different colour and size icons on the Abandoned Kingdom map to reflect what difficulty they were beaten on.

Developer note: An extra way to reward players for beating expeditions and recognise the difficulty level - the world map becomes a bit like a trophy cabinet!

New completed expedition icons added to the pool including special ones for Mega Brutal

The game will now warn you if building housing that will need new Services researched. 

Developer note: Another player requested feature so players know if they are in danger of growing too fast and encountering morale issues. This doesn’t apply on Mega Brutal.

Quality of Life

Added Difficulty and Region Name to the settlement screen Overview panel

Increased the size of completed Expedition score boxes

Adjusted padding of World Map for different screens

Changed the fitting of ranking stars on level select to better align with text 

Bug Fixes

Fix for camera zoom when selecting a Campaign whilst already having a Level selected

Fixed an issue with 'Growth Spurt' achievement

Fixed levelled building shadows appearing strange

Fixed an issue with initial Reward Points not being earned in Extra Expeditions if you didn’t have existing rewards

Fixed potential reward bug when saving and loading an Expedition
What's Next?
We're hard at work on a brand new campaign Shadows of the Past which adds new game mechanics and a lot more levels. 

At the same time, we are working on various other features including a control scheme upgrade that lets people use right click to build things in specific areas. More news on all of this soon and we will adjust plans in response to player feedback as always :)


Be sure to leave us a review if you're enjoying the game! or join our Discord to chat with us, try exclusive betas and swap tactics on how to rebuild the world.

notes.title: Update 1: Extra Expeditions
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/9a818519ac2d555ea0450cdb8d4ed5b513376670.png"]

The first update for After Inc: Revival is here - adding more expeditions, Mac support, bugfixes and a number of quality of life enhancements.

Steam Reviews: Your Feedback Matters
It’s been great getting so much feedback from players about what you want to see in the game - I’ve been reading all the forum posts and Steam reviews. Please keep sharing your thoughts so I know what to focus on for upcoming updates.



One of the top requests has been from people who have beaten both campaigns and want to be able to send out more expeditions than just the normal daily ones. We’ve been ‘inspired’ by the Personal Trainer leader in game and as a result, have updated the game with the new Extra Expeditions feature in record time!


Extra Expeditions
You can now send out 30 extra expeditions if you’ve completed the Daily Expeditions. These challenges are seeded and the same for everyone no matter when you play them so no need to rush.


Providing you with a variety of danger, ambition and interesting opportunities, these bonus Expeditions will keep your civilization on its toes while it expands into the unknown.



Full ChangelogNew Features
Mac Support: We're excited to announce that the game now officially supports Mac!

Extra Expeditions: A new "Extra Expeditions" feature has been added, giving you more opportunities for exploration.

Development Poll: Vote on what features you want prioritised in future updates
Quality of Life
Expedition Bubble Size: The size of expedition bubbles has been shrunk for a cleaner look.

Random Level Animation: We've adjusted the animation duration between idle and selected states for random levels on the world map, making transitions smoother.

Leader Selection Info Popups: You'll now find helpful info popups on the leader selection screens.
Bug Fixes
CJK Improvements: CJK text improvements now address a small lag that appeared when opening a screen for the first time.



What's Next?
We're working hard on future updates. You can check out our roadmap to see our plans and also vote in the in game poll to let us know what you think we should be prioritising!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307662/d5c43b7540bf87ef3e569a03bb2320f7b2dec47d.png"]

Be sure to leave us a review if you're enjoying the game! or join our Discord to chat with us, try exclusive betas and swap tactics on how to rebuild the world.

notes.title: Launch Hotfix 3

Bug Fixes
Leader Selection Warning: The leader selection warning on expeditions has been removed.

Micromanagement Achievement: Conditions for unlocking the Micromanagement achievement have been fixed.
Quality of Life
Leader Selection & Survivor Recommendations: Starting leader selection and survivor recommendation popup conditions have been adjusted to only fire when suitable

Impatience Authority Floor: Impatience can no longer reduce your Authority below 5 on Casual, 4 on Normal, and 1 on Brutal difficulties. (previously was 1 on Casual and Normal). Interested to see how players find this - quite a big change but should smooth the difficulty curve between normal and brutal a bit)

notes.title: Launch Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
This update adds in a feature requested by quite a few players as well as some fixes / changes to ensure people don't play at a higher difficulty than they expect.


New Features
Factory Reset Button: A new "Factory Reset" button has been added to the settings screen. You can use this to wipe your progress if you want. BE CAREFUL!
Quality of Life
Leader Selection Adjustments: More challenging leaders have been moved out of the initial selection pools in early levels (that haven't been beaten).

Localisation Review Popup: A localisation review popup will now be displayed.

Various translation improvements - thanks to the community for all the feedback. Your suggestions on crowdin are being added every update!
Bug Fixes
New Garden Event Soft Lock: Fixed an issue where players could get soft-locked by not having enough resources in the "New Garden" event.

notes.title: Launch Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Quality of Life
Housing Warning Popup: Players on higher difficulty are growing their settlements too fast which causes them to lose control. The housing warning popup now includes more info and stays visible at Brutal difficulty until level 5 to help warn against this..

Early Access to Campaigns & Expeditions: You can now access the second campaign and daily expeditions before finishing the Survival Campaign, offering more ways to play sooner!

Improved level display UI: We have seen some confusion about how many levels there are in the game. We now clearly show there are 18 levels in various places.

Mac: The game is still not officially available for Mac, but people who are playing unofficially will now be able to access latest version. 
[hr][/hr]Fixes
Steam Leaderboards Fix: Remaining Leaderboards should now correctly appear on Steam.

Resource Sidebar Update: The resource sidebar items will now update correctly when you buy technologies in the settlement screen.

Random Level and Region Placement: We've adjusted the positions of random levels and regions around the Survival Campaign and on the world map to prevent them from clashing with campaign pins.

Campaign Title Styling: Campaign titles on the world map now have updated styling.

Quitting Game Crash Fix: An issue causing a crash when quitting the game has been resolved.

Decision Bubbles Fix: Decision bubbles should no longer visually pause.

Soldier Reinforcement Crash Fix: A crash that occurred when reinforcing already dead soldiers has been fixed.
[hr][/hr]Minor Changes
Widget Shadow Mask Sorting: The sorting method for widget shadow masks has been updated.

Desktop Icon Resolution: The desktop icon's resolution has been improved for a sharper look.

News Carousel Images: Images for Plague Inc and Rebel Inc on the news carousel now use the correct icons.

Settlement Naming Keybind: The back button keybind is now disabled when you're typing in the settlement name field.

Quarry Shadows: Quarry shadow shapes have been set.

Ruined Coal Mine Images: Ruined coal mine images have been lightened.

Save File Size Reduction: The save file size has been reduced.

Crater Images: Crater images have been unsharpened.

Ruined Settlement Size Fix: The size of ruined settlements has been fixed.

Map Modifier Icons: Issues with map modifiers showing the wrong icon in the main menu have been resolved.

Map Modifier Colors: Selected state colors for map modifiers have been fixed.

Herb Farm Shadows: Herb farm shadow shapes have been improved.

Windmill Animation: Windmill animation should now be less jerky.

Settlement Button Layout Fix: The layout of the settlement button will no longer break if the text for patience runs too long.

Resource Side Bar: The resource side bar now shows total/deficit resources, and hides the value when the bar is hidden.
